name: stone golem
desc: Stone Golem is a CR 10 construct.
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

actions.name: slow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets one or more creatures it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=o1gVWezg9dluEi5a]] of it. Each target must make a [[/save]] saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=o1gVWezg9dluEi5a]]. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: immutable form
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: magic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical.
